test_wmean_unweighted: test the wmean function computing an unweighted mean over PyTorch tensors on CUDA
test_wmean_weighted: test the wmean function computing a weighted mean using a weight tensor
test_wmean_keepdim: test the wmean function with keepdim=True to preserve the reduced dimension
test_wmean_broadcasting: test the wmean function broadcasting weights across batched tensor inputs
test_masked_gather_errors: test the masked_gather function error handling for unsupported index formats and mismatched batch dimensions
